name: RST4 Discovery Promotion Rule
description: Frozen mathematical criteria for selecting a single robust recipe from the RST4 Discovery Staircase for subsequent confirmation in RST6/RST7.

selection_algorithm.step_1: Evaluate eligibility of R1, R2, R3 under Route D1 or Route D2 relative to R0.
selection_algorithm.step_2: If no candidate satisfies either Route D1 or Route D2, output decision 'NO_RECIPE_PROMOTED' with selected_recipe=null.
selection_algorithm.step_3: Among eligible candidates, identify the maximum event_macro_f1 value.
selection_algorithm.step_4: Form candidate pool of all eligible recipes whose event_macro_f1 is within parsimony_equivalence_bandwidth (0.005) of the maximum.
selection_algorithm.step_5: Select the simplest recipe according to structural hierarchy: R1 precedes R2 precedes R3.
selection_algorithm.step_6: Promote exactly one selected recipe and freeze parameters for RST5.
